candidates.name: Practice Guide 41 supplement 6: voluntary application to note overriding interests
verified_facts: The HMLR supplement describes a voluntary registration procedure for noting overriding interests on developing estates.
Its purpose is legal-record management and application procedure rather than physical surveying.
semantic_limits: Recording or noting a legal interest provides no numeric terrain height, vertical datum or survey-accuracy evidence.

candidates.name: How to report an error
verified_facts: HM Land Registry provides a process to report suspected errors in register entries, title plans or copy documents.
The guidance reflects an explicit correction pathway for document integrity.
semantic_limits: The existence of an error-reporting or correction process does not certify parcel geometry or elevation measurement accuracy; source measurements remain independently verifiable.
